content:
This week, Apple updated its third-party accessories lineup, adding eight new products, including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.

Aqara first showcased the Thermostat Hub W200 at CES 2026 back in January and officially launched it in April.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 is priced at US$169.95 at Apple. Although it is US$10 more expensive than on Amazon, if you have Apple credit available, or you are already shopping at Apple, this option is far more convenient.

Apple adding this product to its online and physical stores represents a significant vote of confidence. It also specially supports Apple Home exclusive features, such as Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.

Apple also sells the higher-priced ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which supports built-in Siri and uses HomeKit rather than supporting HomeKit via Matter.

That said, the Aqara version is still quite attractive, supporting Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance through the Apple Home app.

This week's Apple Store inventory update also includes another Aqara smart home product: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100.

In addition to these two Aqara smart home products, Apple now also sells the following six accessories:

  • Nimble Powerstack Charger/Battery System
  • Herschel Cloudform Sleeve for 14″ MacBook
  • Herschel Cloudform Sleeve for 16″ MacBook
  • Herschel Cloudform Backpack XL for MacBook
  • CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable (2.0m)
  • Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote

Coming up next is the highly anticipated launch of the iPhone Duo later this month, as well as a product reportedly dubbed the "HomePod with a display" expected in October.
